species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 63°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–32 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
Southeast wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the northwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
